description: 96 mm panel multifunction meter Nemo 96HD/HD+ with the RS-485 Modbus module
source: IME, "Nemo 96HD/HD+ Modbus communication protocol", PR 106 rev. 4 (2012-12-18), firmware 2.30 and later
notes: Read with FC03; 32-bit values are most significant word first. Values marked BYTE in the protocol are sent as a word with a zero high byte.
Powers in the 0x1000 block are W/var/VA divided by 100 when KTA x KTV < 5000 and in W/var/VA otherwise; the signed powers at 0x1518 are always W/var.
Energies are split into a low part in Wh (up to 999999) and a high part in MWh.
Not in this map: the first address table (0x0301-0x03FF), which carries the same values, and the setup and module parameter blocks (0x2000-0x2700).
